RED: admit only if V3.2F conclusion overturned by new evidence; default REJECT_RED
SAFETY_CAR: restart transition explicit with no factual future
pit-validity boundary explicit (green-flag R6 valid under SC or REJECT)
VSC: duration calibration slope in [0.5, 1.5] on held-future episodes AND duration MAE <= 1.5 laps
during-VSC pace MAE <= 10.0 s (past-only median rule)
field-spread ratio during/before in [0.5, 1.5] (no bunching/dispersion pathology)
WET: runnable candidate exists (weather evolution + compound transition both causal)
wet pace MAE <= 6.0 s on held-future wet laps
compound-transition policy explicit and separable from Strategy 2.0
YELLOW: exact at-T affected-driver exposure established causally; else REJECT_YELLOW (no global penalty)
common: determinism (same seed equality; domain-separated RNG; no perturbation of DRY_GREEN streams)

comparison_policy.comparator: accepted DRY_GREEN MC2 E (arm E_AR1_RESIDUAL, rho=0.264) for green segments only
comparison_policy.no_retune: dry parameters never retuned on regime outcomes
comparison_policy.unit: race/episode is the high-level statistical unit

fallback_policy.sparse_cells: back off to coarser conditioning (era -> global); report N and fallback

forbidden: future TrackStatus / race-control / weather / rainfall / compounds / pits / lap timing at or after T
altering DRY_GREEN MC2-E behavior or retuning dry params on regime outcomes
ML classifiers/predictors; winner-model probabilities; Strategy 2.0; Counterfactual Lab; frontend; demo cache

SAFETY_CAR.compression: mandatory interpretable field-bunching model from historical evidence; no overtaking
SAFETY_CAR.duration: past-only episode distribution/survival; rng mc2-sc-duration; never factual end
SAFETY_CAR.pits: audit R6 green-flag pit validity under SC; REJECT_SC if SC-aware pits needed but inseparable from Strategy 2.0

VSC.duration: empirical residual-duration distribution conditional on elapsed VSC age (past-only laps); P(continue|age=a) from historical survival; no factual end read
VSC.exit: transition back to accepted DRY_GREEN MC2 E with explicit anchor/AR/gap state; no factual restart observations
VSC.gaps: evidence audit only (preserve/compress/expand); no overtaking mechanism
VSC.pace: VSC-specific central offset + driver variation + variance estimated past-only; minimal supported choice among {freeze, carry-shrunk, reset}

VSC_ENDING.mechanism: token-semantics audit only; ending transition iff token proven factual-at-T; no inferred green timestamp

WET.driver_state: evaluate dry-anchor transfer; choose among {carry-shrunk, reset, wet-anchor} on causal evidence BEFORE outcome scoring
WET.pace: temporal hierarchy INTERMEDIATE/WET by era (x circuit/rain-state/phase only if N supports); past-only
WET.residual: estimate variance/autocorr where supported; else simpler justified process (no auto rho=0.264 reuse)
WET.tyre_transition: audit R6 dry-filtered boundary; minimal empirical rule only if separable from Strategy 2.0, else REJECT_WET
WET.weather_evolution: historical transition/survival over {WET, INTERMEDIATE, DRY} if supported; no ML; rng mc2-weather-transition

YELLOW.mechanism: investigation only: causal sector->driver exposure from Phase12 artifacts without future info or subsystem coupling; no global pace penalty ever

metrics: winner log-loss / Brier, expected-finish MAE, RPS (only if an integrated simulator exists; else NOT_MEASURABLE_OFFLINE)

seed_policy.rule: deterministic seeds only; same-seed equality required; DRY_GREEN streams unperturbed
